name: Sofia Carvalho
bio:
Sofia's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. While studying art restoration in Lisbon, she took a part-time job at a local garage that occasionally prepped rally cars. Fascinated by the meticulous attention to detail required for bodywork and paint, she gradually shifted her focus, apprenticing under a master painter renowned for his intricate designs. She quickly realized that her artistic skills transferred perfectly to the motorsport world.

Sofia's approach to paintwork is both technical and artistic. She's a stickler for precision, meticulously matching colors and applying coatings for optimal performance and aesthetics. She also has a keen eye for design and is always looking for innovative ways to enhance a car's visual appeal. Her willingness to experiment with new techniques and materials, combined with her strong management skills, makes her a valuable asset to any team. Sofia is particularly known for her ability to create stunning livery designs that are both eye-catching and aerodynamic, giving the team a competitive edge, on and off the track.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often tied back in a practical ponytail during work
physical.description: Sofia has a warm smile and a focused gaze that reflects her dedication to her craft.

quirks: Always has a small sketchpad and pencil in her pocket for jotting down design ideas.
Insists on listening to Fado music while working to help focus.
Meticulously cleans her paint guns after every use, regardless of how busy she is.
